## Postman (Remote)

Postman's hosted MCP server lets you inspect and update API collections, environments, and workspaces from an AI assistant. This entry uses the Minimal toolset to keep discovery focused; Postman also offers Code (`/code`) and Full (`/mcp`) endpoints for broader workflows.

### Setup

Create a Postman account and ensure you have access to the workspaces you want to use. Run `thv run postman-remote --remote-auth` to sign in through Postman's OAuth flow; the service supports dynamic client registration, so you do not need to pre-create an OAuth application. For API-key authentication, create a [Postman API key](https://postman.postman.co/settings/me/api-keys) and pass it with `--remote-auth-bearer-token <POSTMAN_API_KEY>` or the corresponding token-file option; the server expects `Authorization: Bearer <POSTMAN_API_KEY>`. EU accounts use `https://mcp.eu.postman.com/minimal` and require API-key authentication because the EU endpoint does not support OAuth. The hosted server cannot reach APIs on your workstation or private network. See the [remote setup guide](https://learning.postman.com/docs/reference/postman-api/postman-mcp-server/postman-mcp-remote-server).
